description: Per-instance official AOCC (index = row of the official instance files) of published MA-BBOB competition entries, computed from their logged data by scripts/mabbob_compare.py build-reference. Regenerate it, do not edit it.

NeighborhoodAdaptiveDE.attribution: 'NeighborhoodAdaptiveDE for Many-Affine Black-box optimization', Anonymous (Zenodo, 2025), doi:10.5281/zenodo.15074959; designed with the LLaMEA framework (van Stein & Baeck, IEEE TEVC 2024). Winner of the 2025 competition. The per-instance scores here are computed from its logged data.

ERADS.attribution: Baseline shipped with the MA-BBOB 2025 getting-started archive (MABBOB_Baselines.zip in IOHprofiler/IOHdata, which states no licence); only derived per-instance scores are stored here.

PSS.attribution: Baseline shipped with the MA-BBOB 2025 getting-started archive (MABBOB_Baselines.zip in IOHprofiler/IOHdata, which states no licence); only derived per-instance scores are stored here. Not the data of Almonacid's figshare record 26026381, which ran on another instance set and another configuration.

ACA.attribution: Baseline shipped with the MA-BBOB 2025 getting-started archive (MABBOB_Baselines.zip in IOHprofiler/IOHdata, which states no licence); only derived per-instance scores are stored here.
